summary: This resolution honors the service and sacrifice of United States Army Sergeant William Nathaniel Howard and Sergeant Edgar Brian Torres-Tovar, who were killed in action in Palmyra, Syria, condemns the terrorist attack, and extends sympathies to their families.

scores.thoughts: This resolution honors fallen soldiers and acknowledges their service in a counter-terrorism engagement. While it touches upon military actions and personnel, it does not propose any changes to military spending or policy, focusing solely on recognition and sympathy.
